title: Presence from_cbor ignores trailing CBOR bytes
description:
File: rust/lichen-client/src/presence.rs (Presence::from_cbor, PresenceCache::from_cbor)

Both decoders call ciborium::from_reader(bytes) and return the first value. Leftover bytes are not checked.

Untrusted GET /presence and GET /presence/cache payloads (PresenceClient) can therefore carry a second CBOR item after a valid map. Sibling decoders in the same crate already reject this: NodeConfig::from_cbor and RadioConfig::from_cbor use a Cursor and error when position != len, with tests for trailing 0x00.

Fix: decode via Cursor, require position == bytes.len(), and add tests for truncated and trailing payloads (same pattern as config.rs). Apply to Presence and PresenceCache.

Perspectives: robustness, security.
close_reason: Presence::from_cbor and PresenceCache::from_cbor now decode via Cursor and reject leftover bytes (same pattern as NodeConfig). Tests cover truncated and trailing 0x00 payloads. cargo test -p lichen-client --lib presence and --test presence_vectors green.
